content.hebrew: אֱמֶת הַשָּׁמַֽיִם כִּסְאֶֽךָ, וְהָאָֽרֶץ הֲדוֹם רַגְלֶֽךָ,
content.transliteration: Emet hash’shamayim kis’ekha, veha’arets hadom raḡlekha,
content.english: In truth, the heavens are Your throne, and the earth is Your footstool;

content.hebrew: הַאֻמְנָם תֵּשֵׁב עִם הָאָדָם, וְהַשָּׁמַֽיִם לֹא יְכַלְכְּלֽוּךָ?
content.transliteration: Ha’umnam teshev ‘im ha’adam, vehash’shamayim lo yekhalkelukha?
content.english: Can You indeed dwell amidst humanity, when the heavens cannot contain You?
Thought is too limited to understand Your greatness.
Your armies are awesome visions and wondrous forms.

content.hebrew: אֵי זֶה בַֽיִת אֲשֶׁר יִבְנוּ לְךָ, וְאֵי זֶה תַאֲוָה וּגְבוּל יַגְבִּילֶֽךָ?
content.transliteration: Ē zē vayit asher yivnu lekha, ve’ē zē ta’ava uḡvul yaḡbilekha?
content.english: What is the house that they could build for You, and what line and border could bound You?

content.hebrew: וּמַֽעְלָה וּמַֽטָּה וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר בָּהֶם פֳּעָלֶֽיךָ,
content.transliteration: Uma‘la umatta vekhol asher bahem pa‘olekha,
content.english: [That which is] above and below, and all that are in them, are Your works,
So where is the place that could contain You?
Your attributes are mercy, and Your ways are righteousness,
Justice and uprightness are Your teachings and rulings.
You cannot be evaluated, and to whom could one compare You?
Your spheres are founded on sockets of desire,
They rotate, to apprehend the beauty of Your praises—
The moon and the stars have dominion over the night,
And the sun, in the daytime, shines in Your precinct.
Glorious souls make music to You;

content.hebrew: וּכְרוּבִים וְשִׁנְאָנִים וְאֹפַנִּים סְבִיבֶֽיךָ, וְלֹא יָדְעוּ שְׁבִילֶֽיךָ.
content.transliteration: Ukhruvim veshin’anim ve’ofannim sevivekha, velo yade‘u shevilekha.
content.english: Cherubim, shin’anim, and ofannim surround You, but do not know Your paths;
content.comments: Cherubim, shin’anim, and ofannim. Various types of angels.

content.english: And flaming seraphim sing Your might in Your palace,

content.hebrew: בְּלִי מָדוֹן, לִפְנֵי הָאָדוֹן, עוֹנִים מַהֲלָלֶֽיךָ.
content.english: Without strife, in front of the Master, they respond with Your praise.

content.hebrew: קהל: וְנוֹתְנִים רְשׁוּת זֶה לָזֶה, לְהַלֵּל בְּרָב גָּדְלֶֽךָ.
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Venotenim reshut zē lazē, lehallel berov godlekha.
content.english: Cong. And they give permission to one another to laud [You] regarding Your immense greatness.

content.hebrew: חזן: תְּנ֥וּ עֹ֗ז לֵֽאלֹ֫הִ֥ים עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל גַּֽאֲוָת֑וֹ וְ֝עֻזּ֗וֹ בַּשְּׁחָקִֽים: נ֤וֹרָ֥א אֱלֹהִ֗ים מִמִּקְדָּ֫שֶׁ֥יךָ אֵ֤ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל ה֤וּא נֹתֵ֨ן ׀ עֹ֖ז וְתַֽעֲצֻמ֥וֹת לָעָ֗ם בָּ֘ר֥וּךְ אֱלֹהִֽים: (תהלים סח:לה-לו)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Tenu ‘oz lElohim ‘al Yisra’el ga’avato ve‘uzzo bash’sheḥaḳim: Nora Elohim mimmiḳdashekha el Yisra’el hu noten, ‘oz veta‘atsumot la‘am barukh Elohim:
content.english: Cantor. Ascribe might to God; His pride is over Israel, and His might is in the heavens. God is awesome from your temples; the God of Israel gives might and formidability to the people; blessed be God! (Ps. 68:35–36)

content.hebrew: חַי־יו֖י וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְ֝יָר֗וּם אֱלוֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי: (תהלים יח:מז)
content.transliteration: Ḥai Adonai uvarukh tsuri, veyarum elohē yish‘i:
content.english: Adonai lives, and my Rock is blessed; and may the God of my rescue be lofty. (Ps. 18:47)

content.hebrew: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יו֤י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְ֭הִֽשְׁתַּֽחֲווּ לַֽהֲדֹ֥ם רַגְלָ֗יו קָ֘ד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא: (תהלים צט:ה)
content.transliteration: Romemu Adonai elohenu vehishtaḥavu lahadom raḡlav ḳadosh hu:
content.english: Declare the loftiness of Adonai our God, and prostrate yourselves to his footstool—holy is He! (Ps. 99:5)

content.hebrew: קהל: קָד֧וֹשׁ ׀ קָד֛וֹשׁ קָד֖וֹשׁ יו֣י צְבָא֑וֹת מְלֹ֥א כָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ: (ישעיהו ו:ג)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ḳadosh, ḳadosh ḳadosh Adonai tseva’ot melo khol ha’arets kevodo:
content.english: Congregation: Holy, holy, holy is Adonai Ẓeva’oth; the entire world is full of His Glory. (Isa. 6:3)
content.comments: Adonai Ẓeva’oth. A common name for God in Scripture; traditional English: “Lord of Hosts.”
